entries.title: AI label in a surface: Sofia at md (24), the size that reads beside text (#9)
entries.text: Inside an AI surface (Suggested reply and every drafted block) the label's Sofia draws at md instead of sm; -my-1 keeps the title row the height of its text.

entries.title: Inception stage, nav and layout, a live homepage, morphing icons (#10)
entries.text: * Inception: Vita's stage explains itself; the header caps at 1024px; the canvas hugs its cards

entries.title: Phone polish: full-width menu over a full dim, steppers that hold, calendar height glides (#8)
entries.text: Menu sheet: full width on a phone (inset like the header); the dim covers the whole window, under the bottom header, which stays live above it.

entries.title: Toggle: a dragged knob stays in its track (#7)
entries.text: The drag moved the knob with an inline transform while the resting classes (translate-x-*) set the CSS translate property, so both applied: an "on" knob started 24px in and slid out of the track. The drag now sets translate inline, which replaces the class value while dragging.

entries.title: Built for the thumb: hold gestures, icon-only buttons, cards for tables, the header at the bottom (#6)
entries.text: Every control a finger can hold now answers the hold, and phone layouts fold instead of overflowing.

entries.title: The slogan: The first agentic design system (#5)
entries.text: Made for AI products, and for the agents that build them. On the showcase hero and page title, the README, the package description, AGENTS.md, About and the copywriting rules. Decision: a new record, The slogan, supersedes the slogan line of The name is Vita (dated revision); the name, the triad and Theo stand.

entries.title: Sofia generating: shapes hold longer, pour into the next, slimmer line (#4)
entries.text: Each shape holds about 1.3s of liquid time (was 1s) before changing.

entries.title: Capsule or notification: one decision, taught to agents and people (#3)
entries.text: Decide by what the message asks of the person: needs fixing → InlineNotification by the cause; read or undo, caused by the person → toast; a system state to glance at → capsule. Written into the Architect skill, the Notifications pattern (with a capsule row and worked examples), and the Capsule and Notification pages. A capsule never carries an error; it hands over to an InlineNotification.

entries.title: Scramble text, Draft stage, renamed skills and a polish pass (#2)
entries.text: * Scramble text, Draft stage, renamed skills and a polish pass

entries.title: Sofia stays slim and glossy on the GPU renderer
entries.text: Big orbs hand over to the GPU renderer when the filter runs late (and phones use it from the start); it drew lines about twice as thick and flat. Drops now blend as a soft union (sparse drops still bridge, dense outlines don't pile up), at their true size (the ×1.3 only compensates the filter's melt), with a broad sheen on the body as well as the rim highlight.

entries.title: Components and patterns: composites move to Patterns; Sofia's seven states in one place
entries.text: Decision: a component is one building block with one job; a pattern is made of several components. Recorded in docs/decisions/components-and-patterns.md and AGENTS.md.

entries.title: Small idle Sofia is the Vita mark
entries.text: At 16 to 24px, idle draws a thin liquid ring with a drop at its heart (the mark), with a tighter melt, instead of a blob that read as a dot. The email provenance header shows Sofia at 24px; Thinking documents 24px as the smallest Sofia beside text.

entries.title: Avatar matches the design in Vita colours; Sofia stays recognisable at 16px
entries.text: Avatar: a muted blue gradient mixed only from palette tokens (20% blue-600 in gray-100 to 45% indigo-700 in gray-200), white initials.

entries.title: Tooltips name, never instruct
entries.text: The card status tooltip says 'In progress', not 'Change status': the pointer and hover state already say it's clickable. New rule in Tooltip, Content (don't explain the obvious) and the recognition principle (signifiers teach; words don't repeat them).

entries.title: Avatar, Email message, the Cards pattern; full-height empty states
entries.text: Avatar (new): photo or initials, white on a soft grey gradient; sm 24, md 32, lg 40.

entries.title: Every search answers 'nothing' with an empty state
entries.text: The docs sidebar filter, global search and Combobox show an EmptyState (search pictogram, the query, a hint, Clear where it helps) instead of blank space. Search, Empty states and Choosing a component make it a rule for every search.

entries.title: Progress bar: the liquid stays inside its track, with Sofia's viscosity
entries.text: The liquid canvas is exactly the track (it was three times taller and spilled out), clipped to its rounded ends. The melt uses Sofia's ratio of blur to drop size, so the tip and its trailing drop stretch through thick, rounded necks.

entries.title: Phones keep a 16px body so fields never zoom
entries.text: At 15px iOS zoomed the page on field focus. Body type floors at 16px on touch again (fields included); headings stay in proportion through the tighter narrow-screen scale. Touch decision revision updated.

entries.title: Right panel: a solid, full-height, scrolling body
entries.text: Between header and footer the content sits on its own page-coloured surface (no blur), concentric with the panel, scrolling on its own; only the frame is glass. The theme panel tightens its spacing.

entries.title: Phones end to end; colours with names; squircles on iPhone
entries.text: Type in proportion on phones: body floors at 15px (fields stay 16px so iOS never zooms), the scale tightens to at most 1.15 under 640px, big headings lighten a step. Recorded as a revision of the Touch decision.

entries.title: Theme panel: choose by seeing (SwatchPicker, PreviewPicker); no sliders
entries.text: SwatchPicker (new): one colour from a row of equal circles, the chosen name beside the label; a radio group with a ring that eases onto the choice.

entries.title: Write for the scan; Brand & voice folds into Content
entries.text: Content: 'Write for the scan' (the point first, headings that start with the information, grouped sections, descriptive links, lists) and 'Concise, scannable, objective' (about half the words, two-sentence paragraphs, readable lines). Principle 2 carries the same rule.

entries.title: Identity section, new About Vita, four design principles; Interaction folds into Principles
entries.text: Sidebar: a new Identity section (About Vita; Animus, anima, vita; Brand & voice; Design principles) after Getting started. Pages move to docs/identity; old links redirect.

entries.title: Vita is labelled Experimental
entries.text: The header badge and the hero tag use the same status word as experimental pages (warning tone). The brand page counts the audit's 17 rules.

entries.title: Radius follows the theme everywhere; Alpha label in the header and hero
entries.text: rounded-pill: tags, chips, capsules and the AI label stay pills at any radius and square off when the theme is square.

entries.title: Progress bars pour Sofia's liquid; Spotlight is a pill until it has results
entries.text: ProgressBar draws with the thinking orb's shader: a body of melted drops, lit rim and glow. Determinate springs to the value and stretches a drop ahead when it moves fast; indeterminate pumps a slug slowly along (about 3.6 s a crossing, was far quicker) with a trailing droplet. The CPU liquid remains the fallback. Physics runs in fixed steps, so slow frames never slow it down.

entries.title: Tag: a leading icon is inset as much as it is from the top and bottom
entries.text: Left padding with an icon: 2px (sm), 4px (md, was 8px), 8px (lg).

entries.title: Header: See what you can make; Thinking explains why a spinner can't do the job
entries.text: The global nav links to the live examples page from everywhere (active on it).

entries.title: Only Vita: the naming record, changelog and repo speak as Vita
entries.text: The naming decision explains Vita and the triad, with no former name.

entries.title: Never ask for the visitor's location
entries.text: useSunTheme no longer calls the geolocation API: the timezone estimate (within about an hour of the real sunset) drives the theme and the weather tint. A theme is not worth a permission prompt.

entries.title: Voice: ConversationBar, LiveWaveform, MicSelector, useMicrophone; Sofia idles, listens and talks
entries.text: useMicrophone: device list, permission on start only, mute, live level and frequency bands (pull-based, per frame); simulatedVoice / simulatedBands for previews.

entries.title: The Vita mark: a frame of Sofia, generating
entries.text: A liquid spectrum ring with one drop at its heart and a glint on the lit rim; light and dark variants (softer glint, paler heart on dark). The favicon is the same drawing with the palette resolved to hex.

entries.title: Sofia on phones: the desktop liquid, on the GPU, at full resolution
entries.text: The CPU field drew a 128-cell grid and upscaled it, so phones saw a soft, low-detail orb. A WebGL2 shader now evaluates the desktop filter chain per pixel: each drop's blurred disk in closed form, summed (gooey bridges), thresholded where the chain does, rim-lit from the top left with an exact slope, and a pastel glow behind. Glints stay crisp on the 2D canvas above. The CPU field remains the fallback where WebGL2 isn't available.

entries.title: Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'
Homepage: hero and component canvas only
entries.text: The pillars and theme presets leave the homepage.

entries.title: Touch adapts by itself; the thinking orb draws without filters on phones; the icon catalog leaves the shared chunk (#1)
entries.text: Mobile was slow for three reasons, fixed here:

entries.title: Homepage: Sofia at the epicenter; 'See what you can make' gets its own page
entries.text: The hero centres on Sofia (Thinking generating, new 3xl 280px size for a landing page's epicenter); the component canvas stays right below.

entries.title: Rename the Loading component page to Thinking
entries.text: docs/components/loading.md → thinking.md; manifest, demos, sources and every 'related' list follow.

entries.title: Sofia flows: full frame rate, soft gaps, every figure moves, expressive modes
entries.text: Drawn every display frame (30/40fps caps made the liquid step).

entries.title: Sofia: outlined and segmented shapes, coloured glints, livelier motion
entries.text: Generating draws OUTLINES again (a filled body all looked alike), plus minimal segmented figures: dashed ring, three arcs, ( ), =, +, ×, ≡, wave, open C, three dots.

entries.title: Sofia: precise retrieving, many defined shapes for generating
entries.text: Retrieving uses a tighter melt: each recalled particle stays a distinct drop until it reaches the core.

entries.title: Sofia is super gooey: no sharp edges
entries.text: Wider goo blur with a gentler threshold: drops reach for each other through thick, rounded bridges instead of pinching.

entries.title: Button hover: the glare takes the squircle shape
entries.text: The tilt glare (::after) inherited the radius but not corner-shape, so on hover a plain rounded rectangle showed past the squircle , most visible on secondary buttons.

entries.title: Glass keeps its blur in production builds
entries.text: The minifier collapsed backdrop-filter + -webkit-backdrop-filter into the prefixed one only, which Chrome ignores. Declare the unprefixed property and let the build add the prefix.

entries.title: Ignore Vercel link and env files
Filtering: one row in the data table's toolbar
entries.text: Search, applied filter tags, Clear filters and the Filter trigger share the DataTable toolbar; the result count is the table description.

entries.title: Chat: earlier messages glide when the agent replies, never snap
entries.text: useFlip measures children relative to its container. Nested FLIP containers (chat thread inside its scroller) double-compensated the parent's move, so the column jumped down then slid back.

entries.title: Deploy-ready: showcase at the root, docs at /docs
entries.text: build:site renames the showcase to index.html and the docs to docs.html.

entries.title: Modal: every dismissal falls, only success flies up
entries.text: The exit stayed 'send' after one successful action, so later click-outside, Escape or × dismissals flew up. Each open and each dismissal now resets it to 'fall'.

entries.title: Dialog glass near-opaque (glass-4 fill 80%)
entries.text: Supersedes the 44% revision in the glass decision: dialogs must read as a solid sheet. Other tiers unchanged.

entries.title: Modal send exit stays solid until it leaves the viewport
entries.text: No fade: the sent modal travels the full viewport height at full opacity (240ms, accelerating), after the shorter 320ms success hold.

entries.title: Dialogs read first; successful modals leave faster
entries.text: glass-4 (dialogs, Spotlight) fill 12% → 44% so they no longer blend into the page; recorded as a revision of the glass decision.

entries.title: Spotlight previews one component; the docs home page is gone
entries.text: Component previews show ONE instance: the hero demo is trimmed down its layout wrappers to the first real component, centred, with room for full-width controls.

entries.title: Spotlight previews are never blank
entries.text: Content that sizes to its container (shells, full-width panels, chat panels, the Material demo) collapsed to zero width in the shrink-to-fit frame; it now lays out on a fixed 640px stage and is scaled down like a screenshot.

entries.title: Global search: Spotlight with live previews; header search button, dot separator, GitHub forks
entries.text: GlobalSearch (new component + pattern): a search button among the header's global actions (⌘K) summons a Spotlight-style glass panel near the top of the screen , no scrim, a large regular-weight field, results grouped by section with the top hit highlighted; arrows move, Enter opens, Esc clears then dismisses. A preview square shows the highlighted result made tangible: the page's live hero demo (shrunk to fit, inert), colour swatches for Color, a huge 'Aa' for Typography. Previews are lazy (functions), so only the shown one renders. Best-match ranking: labels starting with the query first.

entries.title: Header nav: lava-lamp highlight between links
entries.text: HeaderNav renders one highlight pill that slides (expressive spring) to the current link when the page changes, like the tabs pill; the active link keeps its weight and colour but no fill of its own. useIndicator now follows aria-current, and a resize right after a selection change (the new item turns medium weight) still slides instead of snapping , tabs and content switcher benefit too.

entries.title: One global nav everywhere
entries.text: src/playground/nav.ts holds the global nav (Start · Foundations · Components · Patterns · Decisions); the docs header and the showcase header both render it (the showcase links into the docs), so the top nav is the same on every page.

entries.title: Date picker morphs and returns to today; day states; header nav; highlighted option contrast
entries.text: Calendar: the frame eases between month heights (no snap), the month name morphs in with the default stagger, the year shows only when it isn't this year, and a Today button reveals beneath the grid once you leave the current month. Today's day has a small dot under the number.

entries.title: Focused fields stay white
entries.text: Text fields (and every field built on fieldClasses) and the composer keep the white field background while focused, even under the pointer; the grey hover fill now only applies at rest.

entries.title: Numbers are regular weight everywhere; mono demo shows a number
entries.text: Text renders numeric-only content ('12,840', '94%', '€1,240') in regular weight even inside a semibold role, unless a weight is passed explicitly (tabular-nums already enforced it for animated numbers, tables and KPIs). The Typography Mono demo uses 12,840 as its sample.
